headline: Result Update

highlights: Management attributed strong execution to faster deliveries and efforts to distribute production more evenly across quarters, reducing the historical concentration of business in Q4.
H1 EBITDA margin stood at 27.43%, while profit before tax increased approximately 14.7% to INR 3,467 cr.
The order book stood at INR 68,717 cr as of 1 October 2026, with H1 order inflows of INR 7,334 cr.
Management expected approximately INR 20,000 cr of Next Generation Corvette orders from GRSE and Goa Shipyard, covering radars, electronic warfare and communication equipment, excluding missiles.
valuation: Major programmes included electronic fuzes, LCA Mk1, LR-SAM, BMP-2 upgrades, Ashwini radar and Mi-17 electronic warfare suites, supporting execution visibility across multiple years.
Despite strong first-half growth, management retained FY27 revenue-growth guidance of 15%–20%, with potential upside depending on execution. 2.
